Anivia.escape: After Anivia Q Flash Frost is down is your chance to engage with Vex R Shadow Surge. Even though Anivia has no mobility, Vex has no mobility after dashing either, so check that W and Flash are available. If Anivia P Rebirth is still available, it is difficult to break the egg alone, so engage with an ally.
Anivia.build: Get a Null-Magic Mantle first to survive the early game. Anivia's main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Anivia.combo: For a basic trade, slow Anivia with Vex E Looming Darkness, land Vex Q Mistral Bolt, and weave in one basic attack if the Gloom mark remains. If Doom is ready, charge the longer-range Q or the wider-area E with fear to stop Anivia's counterattack. To engage for a kill, hit with the Vex R Shadow Surge projectile, recast to dash in, then use E and Vex W Personal Space after landing.
Anivia.fight: When Anivia steps forward to last-hit minions, chip away at her health with Vex Q Mistral Bolt. For trades, hit her first with the slow from Vex E Looming Darkness, then cast Q. When Anivia Q Flash Frost is down and Rebirth is unavailable, close the gap with Vex R Shadow Surge and look for a kill.
Anivia.laning: Use Q to farm and poke, and save Vex E Looming Darkness for a fight.
Anivia.phase: In the late game, watch out for Anivia's terrain control, and hit a target you can finish with Vex R to chain resets.
Anivia.teamfight: Avoid narrow paths in the jungle and river where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your escape, and start fights in open areas. Engage with Vex R Shadow Surge after Anivia P Rebirth is down and a kill is certain.
Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost can be detonated with a second cast to stun, so avoid it by staying out of range from the start. If Q hits you or you are chilled inside Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals more damage, so immediately leave the storm and use Vex W Personal Space's shield when the damage comes in. In narrow paths, Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape route.

Ahri.phase: In the late game, look for chain engages with Vex R Shadow Surge resets, but do not go in first if the enemy team is grouped and gives you no angle.
Ahri.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against Ahri's main damage, but magic resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception on its return. If the enemy team has several engage assassins, prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass over damage items so you can survive after going in with Vex R Shadow Surge.
Ahri.teamfight: Do not go in first. When Ahri uses R Spirit Rush, stop the dash with a basic ability charged with Vex P Doom 'n Gloom. Then catch the backline with Vex E Looming Darkness. Dodge Ahri E Charm, and when the enemy formation is disrupted and a kill is certain, engage with Vex R Shadow Surge and look for a reset.
Ahri.combo: From range, cast Vex E Looming Darkness to slow Ahri, then follow with Vex Q Mistral Bolt. If the Gloom mark remains, consume it with one basic attack.
Ahri.escape: If Ahri E Charm has also just been spent, close the gap with Vex R Shadow Surge and look for a finish. Vex R Shadow Surge can finish a target hit by its mark; recast it when both Vex W Personal Space and Flash are still available to use after the dash.
Ahri.fight: Look for an opening right after dodging Ahri E Charm or when Ahri R Spirit Rush is down. For a basic trade, slow her with Vex E Looming Darkness, land Vex Q Mistral Bolt, and weave in one basic attack if the Gloom mark remains. If Ahri engages first with R Spirit Rush, stop the dash with a basic ability charged with your saved Vex P Doom 'n Gloom, then counterattack.
Ahri.laning: Move with a minion wave between you and Ahri to block Ahri E Charm. Use Vex Q Mistral Bolt to farm and poke, and punish Ahri when she steps forward to last-hit. Save Vex E Looming Darkness for a fight, and stay back while Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is unavailable after being used on the wave.
Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits you, you can take all the follow-up damage, so dodge it from behind minions. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit on its return, so after dodging the first pass, move out of its return path too. When Ahri uses R Spirit Rush to engage, use a basic ability charged with your saved Vex P Doom 'n Gloom to stop the dash.

Syndra.fight: If Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, slow with Vex E Looming Darkness, hit with Vex Q Mistral Bolt, then add a basic attack if the mark remains. Syndra has no mobility spell, so close the distance with Vex R Shadow Surge when you can finish her.
Syndra.combo: After Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, slow her with Vex E Looming Darkness and fire Vex Q Mistral Bolt. If the Vex P Doom 'n Gloom mark remains, add one basic attack. If you can secure a kill, mark her with Vex R Shadow Surge and recast it to dash in. After landing, shield yourself with Vex W Personal Space.
Syndra.watch: If Syndra Q Dark Sphere is placed between Vex and Syndra, Syndra E Scatter the Weak can stun you with the pushed sphere, so move out of its line. When several spheres are on the ground, watch out for the damage and execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power, and reposition.
Syndra.build: In the early game, survive with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Build magic resistance first against Syndra’s main damage, but also consider health to withstand the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak has a long cooldown and is her only self-defense tool, so the moment after she uses it is your chance to engage.
Syndra.laning: Farm with Vex Q Mistral Bolt and poke Syndra when she steps up to last-hit minions. Save Vex E Looming Darkness for a fight, and use the movement speed from early boots to dodge Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak.
Syndra.phase: In the late game, Vex is strong at chaining engages when takedowns let her use Vex R Shadow Surge again, but it’s hard to make an impact if the enemy groups up and gives her no opening.
Syndra.teamfight: Avoid areas where several Syndra Q Dark Sphere spheres are placed, and move out of the line of spheres that Syndra E Scatter the Weak can knock toward you. Vex should avoid engaging first: interrupt the enemy’s engage with Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear, then control the back line with Vex E Looming Darkness. When the formation breaks and a takedown is assured, go in with Vex R Shadow Surge and look for a reset.

AurelionSol.laning: Pressure Aurelion Sol early before he stacks Stardust, but stay behind minions and dodge the aim line so you do not help his scaling by getting hit by Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light. When he steps forward to last-hit, poke with Vex Q Mistral Bolt, and save Vex E Looming Darkness for a fight. When Vex P Doom 'n Gloom and its fear are ready, do not spend them on the wave so you can respond to Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight.
AurelionSol.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Aurelion Sol's main damage is magic and Vex has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
AurelionSol.combo: If Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, first slow him with Vex E Looming Darkness, then land Vex Q Mistral Bolt. If the Vex P Doom 'n Gloom mark remains, consume it with one basic attack. Only hit with Vex R Shadow Surge and recast to engage when it can lead to a kill, then use the shield from Vex W Personal Space after landing.
AurelionSol.escape: Right after making Aurelion Sol use W Astral Flight is your chance to close the gap with Vex R Shadow Surge. Avoid the crowd control from Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, and engage when Vex W Personal Space is available and you can secure a kill.
AurelionSol.fight: If Aurelion Sol comes in with W Astral Flight, stop the dash with a prepared basic ability charged with Vex P Doom 'n Gloom, then counterattack. After Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, slow him with Vex E Looming Darkness, land Vex Q Mistral Bolt, and close the gap with Vex R Shadow Surge when you can secure a kill.
AurelionSol.phase: Early on, pressure Aurelion Sol while he has little Stardust to slow his scaling. Once Vex gets R Shadow Surge in the mid game, she can engage when the enemy's mobility is down. In the late game, Aurelion Sol's permanent scaling makes the matchup increasingly unfavorable, so Vex should look for an angle to secure a kill and reset Vex R Shadow Surge.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Do not go in first. When Aurelion Sol uses W Astral Flight, stop the engage with a prepared basic ability charged with Vex P Doom 'n Gloom. Then catch the backline with Vex E Looming Darkness, and engage with Vex R Shadow Surge when the enemy formation is disrupted and a kill is certain. Stay spread out from allies so you are not all hit by the area crowd control from Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on maximum health and stacks Stardust, so stand behind minions and quickly leave its aim line. If caught by Aurelion Sol E Singularity, move out immediately, and when low on health, avoid even its edge to prevent an execute. After he has stacked Stardust, spread out from allies to avoid the knock-up and area shockwave from Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.

Ambessa.watch: When you see the shield and windup of Ambessa W Repudiation, stop attacking and walk out of range. After the slow from Ambessa E Lacerate, Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam can follow easily, so as she tries to get on top of you, stop the dash with a basic ability charged with the fear from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom. Ambessa R Public Execution is unstoppable and targets the farthest champion in a straight line, so do not stand in line with your team's backline.
Ambessa.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Ambessa's main damage is physical and Vex has low armor, so build armor first. If the enemy team has several engage assassins, prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass over damage items so you can survive after going in with Vex R Shadow Surge.
Ambessa.combo: For a basic trade, slow Ambessa with Vex E Looming Darkness, land Vex Q Mistral Bolt, and weave in one basic attack if the Gloom mark remains. If Ambessa has already dashed on top of you, charge Vex W Personal Space with Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear to stop the dash and shield yourself from the damage. When you see Ambessa W Repudiation's windup, stop your combo and leave its range.
Ambessa.escape: Right after Ambessa has used all her abilities and spent her Ambessa P Drakehound's Step charges is Vex's window to counterattack. Even if Ambessa R Public Execution is down, her penetration and healing remain, so recast Vex R Shadow Surge to engage only when you can secure a kill and Vex W Personal Space and Flash are available.
Ambessa.fight: Keep your distance while Ambessa's abilities and Ambessa P Drakehound's Step charges remain. Right after Ambessa uses all her abilities and charges, slow her with Vex E Looming Darkness and counterattack with Vex Q Mistral Bolt. Before going in with Vex R Shadow Surge, check whether you can finish the target and whether Vex W Personal Space and Flash are available.
Ambessa.laning: Do not stand forward while Ambessa's abilities are ready, and save Vex E Looming Darkness and Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear for her engage. If you have spent your fear clearing minions, back off because Ambessa can get on top of you.
Ambessa.phase: In the late game, Vex R Shadow Surge is strong for chain engages when it resets on a kill, but wait for an opening if the enemy team is grouped and gives you no angle for R.
Ambessa.teamfight: Do not go in first. When Ambessa engages, stop the dash with a basic ability charged with Vex P Doom 'n Gloom. Then catch the enemy backline with Vex E Looming Darkness, and position so your team's backline is not at the end of Ambessa R Public Execution's line. When the enemy formation is disrupted and a kill is certain, engage with Vex R Shadow Surge and look for a reset.

Cassiopeia.laning: Save Vex E Looming Darkness for trades.
Cassiopeia.build: Cassiopeia deals mostly magic damage, and Vex has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Use a Null-Magic Mantle to hold on in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Cassiopeia.combo: Your basic trade is to slow with Vex E Looming Darkness, hit Vex Q Mistral Bolt, then weave in one auto attack if a Vex P Doom 'n Gloom mark remains. To engage to finish a target, hit with the Vex R Shadow Surge projectile, recast it to dash in, then shield yourself with Vex W Personal Space after landing.
Cassiopeia.escape: Cassiopeia has no movement abilities, so the moment after she uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere is your chance to close the distance with Vex R Shadow Surge. Engage when you can respond to Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze and finish her. If the clouds are already down, don't try to use Vex R Shadow Surge while standing in them; go around.
Cassiopeia.fight: When Cassiopeia steps up to last-hit a minion, briefly poke her with Vex Q Mistral Bolt. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, retreat until the poison ends. If Cassiopeia W Miasma has been used elsewhere and you can finish her, slow her with Vex E Looming Darkness, then engage with Vex R Shadow Surge.
Cassiopeia.phase: Cassiopeia's sustained damage is threatening in the late game, so don't push straight into her. Look to finish her off with certainty using Vex R Shadow Surge and get a reset.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: Don't let Cassiopeia deal sustained damage from the front. Cut off her path or look for the moment after Cassiopeia W Miasma has been used elsewhere. First catch her with a basic ability empowered by Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear and Vex E Looming Darkness. Use Vex R Shadow Surge when their formation is disrupted and a kill is certain, then follow through on the reset.
Cassiopeia.watch: If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, Cassiopeia E Twin Fang deals more damage and provides stronger healing while you're poisoned, so get out of range and fight again once the poison ends. You can't dash with Vex R Shadow Surge inside Cassiopeia W Miasma, so don't step into the clouds. When you see Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze being cast, turn away to avoid the stun.

Viktor.phase: Early on, Viktor P Glorious Evolution has not had time to stack, giving Vex a chance to keep him in check. As the game goes on, Viktor’s scaling stacks up and even the same trades become unfavorable, so use your early advantage.
Viktor.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Viktor’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads and prioritize magic resistance.
Viktor.combo: Slow Viktor with Vex E Looming Darkness, then fire Vex Q Mistral Bolt. If Vex P Doom ’n Gloom’s mark remains, consume it with one basic attack and back off. After engaging with Vex R Shadow Surge, control him with Vex E Looming Darkness and use Vex W Personal Space’s shield.
Viktor.escape: Viktor has no dash to escape on his own, so engage with Vex R Shadow Surge when Viktor W Gravity Field is down. After engaging, Vex has no mobility spell, so first check that Vex W Personal Space and Flash are available.
Viktor.fight: Aggressively chip away at Viktor’s health early, before Viktor P Glorious Evolution has stacked. From outside Viktor W Gravity Field, slow him with Vex E Looming Darkness, then hit him with Vex Q Mistral Bolt. When Viktor W Gravity Field is down, use Vex R Shadow Surge to close the gap if you have a chance to finish him.
Viktor.laning: Farm with Vex Q Mistral Bolt while poking Viktor when he steps up to last-hit minions. Save Vex E Looming Darkness for trades, and don’t waste Vex P Doom ’n Gloom’s fear on the wave. Don’t stand in the line Viktor E Hextech Ray will pass through as it pierces the wave.
Viktor.teamfight: Don’t engage first. From outside Viktor W Gravity Field, catch the backline with Vex E Looming Darkness. When Viktor W Gravity Field is down and his formation is broken, hit a target with Vex R Shadow Surge and engage when a finish is certain. If a marked champion is killed soon after taking R damage, R resets, so look for the next target.
Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so don’t stand in line with the minion wave, and sidestep to dodge it. Viktor W Gravity Field only stuns you if you stay inside, so stop trading and leave immediately when it’s placed. When Viktor R Arcane Storm deals damage, use Vex W Personal Space’s shield to withstand it.

Akali.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Mix in penetration because Akali's high magic resistance can easily block Vex's magic damage.
Akali.combo: For a safe trade, slow Akali with Vex E Looming Darkness, land Vex Q Mistral Bolt, and weave in one basic attack if the Vex P Doom 'n Gloom mark remains. If Akali is already on top of you, stop her engage and gain a shield with Vex W Personal Space when its fear is ready. When Akali hides in W Twilight Shroud, cast Vex Q Mistral Bolt or Vex E Looming Darkness when she briefly becomes visible.
Akali.escape: After dodging Akali E Shuriken Flip or after Akali uses R Perfect Execution is an opportunity for Vex to close the gap. If only one of Akali W Twilight Shroud, E Shuriken Flip, or R Perfect Execution is down, watch for her remaining mobility tools too before deciding whether to recast Vex R Shadow Surge. In particular, look for an opening before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back.
Akali.fight: When Akali tries to get on top of Vex, stop her dash with a basic ability charged with Vex P Doom 'n Gloom, then counterattack. Do not spend Vex W Personal Space on poke; use its shield when Akali gets on top of you to deal burst damage. Before going in with Vex R Shadow Surge, check whether the target can be finished and whether Vex W Personal Space and Flash are available for after you land.
Akali.laning: Farm with Vex Q Mistral Bolt and poke Akali only when she steps forward to last-hit. Save Vex E Looming Darkness for a fight. Stay behind minions while your fear is unavailable after being used on the wave.
Akali.teamfight: Do not go in first. When Akali engages with W Twilight Shroud, E Shuriken Flip, or R Perfect Execution, stop her with a basic ability charged with Vex P Doom 'n Gloom. Then catch the enemy backline with Vex E Looming Darkness. Use Vex R Shadow Surge to look for a reset after the enemy formation is disrupted and a kill is certain.
Akali.watch: If the mark lands, a second dash follows, so if you get hit, save Vex P Doom 'n Gloom and its fear for when they engage, then stop them with a basic ability.

Akshan.build: Akshan's main damage is physical and Vex has low armor, so build armor first. Survive the early game with Cloth Armor, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If the enemy team has several engage assassins, prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass over other damage items so you can survive after going in with Vex R Shadow Surge.
Akshan.combo: For a basic trade, slow Akshan with Vex E Looming Darkness, land Vex Q Mistral Bolt, and consume the Gloom mark with one basic attack if it remains. If Vex P Doom 'n Gloom and its fear are ready, decide first which basic ability to charge with fear so you can respond to Akshan E Heroic Swing. If Vex R Shadow Surge hits a target you can finish, recast it to dash in, then catch them with E as soon as you land and gain a shield with Vex W Personal Space.
Akshan.escape: Akshan E Heroic Swing is his mobility tool, so right after he uses it is your chance to close the gap or catch him out. Engage with Vex R Shadow Surge then if you can secure a kill and Vex W Personal Space and Flash are available. The provided material does not identify a separate window when Akshan's crowd control is down.
Akshan.fight: When Akshan steps forward to last-hit, chip away at his health with Vex Q Mistral Bolt. If Vex E Looming Darkness hits, follow up with Q while Akshan is slowed. If Akshan gets on top of you with E Heroic Swing, stop the dash with a basic ability charged with saved Vex P Doom 'n Gloom, then activate the shield on Vex W Personal Space when the damage comes in. Use Vex R Shadow Surge when Akshan's mobility is down and you can finish him.
Akshan.laning: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range when it hits minions, so watch its path even from behind the wave. If you have spent Vex P Doom 'n Gloom and its fear on the wave, back behind minions and watch for Akshan E Heroic Swing.
Akshan.phase: In the late game, look for chain engages with R resets, but do not go in first if the enemy team is grouped and gives you no angle for R.
Akshan.teamfight: First look to stop Akshan E Heroic Swing with a basic ability charged with Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear. Then catch the backline with Vex E Looming Darkness. Use Vex R Shadow Surge after the formation is disrupted and a kill is certain, and aim so it does not hit the frontline first. If you have Akshan's Scoundrel mark, do not face him alone; fight outside the range at which Akshan can finish you off.
Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits an enemy, so even behind a minion wave, dodge both its outgoing and returning paths. When Akshan engages with E Heroic Swing, save Vex P Doom 'n Gloom and its fear, then stop the dash with a basic ability. If you are low and targeted by Akshan R Comeuppance, do not flee alone into the open; move behind terrain.

Annie.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Annie's damage is mostly magic and Vex has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Annie.combo: For a basic trade, slow Annie with Vex E Looming Darkness, land Vex Q Mistral Bolt, and weave in one basic attack if the Gloom mark remains. Only hit with Vex R Shadow Surge and recast to engage when Annie P Pyromania's stun is down and you can secure a kill.
Annie.escape: Annie has no movement abilities, but Annie E Molten Shield can increase her movement speed, so the moment after she spends Annie P Pyromania's stun is your chance to engage. Close the gap with Vex R Shadow Surge then, but check that Vex W Personal Space is available for after the dash.
Annie.fight: Poke from range while Annie P Pyromania's stun is down. When Annie steps forward, slow her with Vex E Looming Darkness, then land Vex Q Mistral Bolt. Use the shield from Vex W Personal Space when Annie approaches to deal burst damage. Before going in with Vex R Shadow Surge, check whether you can secure a kill and whether Vex W Personal Space is available.
Annie.laning: Use Vex Q Mistral Bolt to farm and poke, and punish Annie when she steps forward to last-hit. Save Vex E Looming Darkness for trades, and keep your distance while Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready.
Annie.phase: In the late game, Vex R Shadow Surge is strong when a kill resets it and lets you chain engages.
Annie.teamfight: Do not stand stacked with several allies when Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready or Annie is missing. When Annie steps forward, slow her with Vex E Looming Darkness and withstand incoming damage with Vex W Personal Space. Use Vex R Shadow Surge after Annie's stun is down and a kill is certain.
Annie.watch: When Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, white light swirls around Annie, so do not enter ability range. After you are hit by the area damage from Annie R Summon: Tibbers, do not stay near Tibbers.

Aurora.build: Aurora deals mostly magic damage, and Vex has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Use a Null-Magic Mantle to hold on in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Aurora.combo: When there's some distance between you, cast Vex E Looming Darkness to slow Aurora, then follow up with Vex Q Mistral Bolt. If a Vex P Doom 'n Gloom mark remains, consume it with one auto attack. If Aurora disappears with Aurora W Across the Veil, place Vex E Looming Darkness where she is likely to arrive, or wait until she reappears.
Aurora.escape: If only one of Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding has been used, she can escape with the other, so don't rush your engage. Once both movement abilities have been used, and before Aurora R Between Worlds comes back up, you have a window to close the distance with Vex R Shadow Surge. Hit Vex R Shadow Surge on a target you can finish, and make sure Vex W Personal Space and Flash are available to survive after the dash.
Aurora.fight: Aurora can engage with Aurora W Across the Veil, Aurora E The Weirding, or Aurora R Between Worlds, so save Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear to interrupt her dash. When Aurora gets close to deal damage, use Vex W Personal Space to shield yourself and retaliate. To trade first, slow her with Vex E Looming Darkness, then hit Vex Q Mistral Bolt; if a mark remains, weave in an auto attack.
Aurora.laning: Save Vex E Looming Darkness for trades, and don't spend Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear on clearing minions. While your fear is unavailable, watch for Aurora's engage and retreat behind your minions.
Aurora.phase: In the late game, Vex R Shadow Surge is powerful when it resets after a kill, but it's harder to contribute if the enemy team stays grouped and gives you no angle to engage.
Aurora.teamfight: Prioritize interrupting Aurora as she engages with Aurora W Across the Veil, Aurora E The Weirding, or Aurora R Between Worlds: use a basic ability empowered by Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear. Then use Vex E Looming Darkness to catch the enemy backline, and go in with Vex R Shadow Surge once their formation is disrupted and you are certain you can finish the target. If Aurora jumps in but kills no one, that's your chance to catch her; if an ally is killed and Aurora's jump resets, watch for her next engage.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when she retrieves the curse, and the retrieval damage increases the more health the target has lost. If it hits you, move off the line between you and Aurora; if your health is low, retreat before she retrieves it. Aurora R Between Worlds slows you when you enter or leave the zone, so decide whether to leave or fight inside before it appears.

Azir.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to survive the early game. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots, and build magic resistance against Azir's main damage.
Azir.combo: First slow Azir with Vex E Looming Darkness, then cast Vex Q Mistral Bolt. If the mark remains, consume it with one basic attack to reduce Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's cooldown. If Azir gets close, gain a shield with Vex W Personal Space, and if fear is ready, use that ability to stop his dash.
Azir.escape: Right after Azir E Shifting Sands is down is your window to close the gap with Vex R Shadow Surge. Dash in when Azir R Emperor's Divide is also down and you can secure a kill, and check that Vex W Personal Space and Flash are available before going in.
Azir.fight: Take short trades while Azir's soldier is stationary or right after Azir E Shifting Sands is down. Slow him with Vex E Looming Darkness, land Vex Q Mistral Bolt, weave in one basic attack if the mark remains, then back away. If Azir engages first with E Shifting Sands, stop the dash with a saved fear ability and counterattack.
Azir.laning: Farm with Vex Q Mistral Bolt and poke Azir when he steps forward to last-hit minions.
Azir.phase: Azir gets stronger as the game goes on, so look for short trades and early pressure, then aim for Vex R Shadow Surge resets on kills in the late game.
Azir.teamfight: The moment Azir engages with E Shifting Sands, stop the dash with a basic ability charged with Vex P Doom 'n Gloom. Then catch the backline with Vex E Looming Darkness, and use Vex R Shadow Surge when the enemy formation is disrupted and you can secure a kill. Do not engage grouped in a narrow passage where Azir R Emperor's Divide can knock you all back.
Azir.watch: Azir Q Conquering Sands moves his soldiers and slows. Move out of the straight line where the soldiers stand, and circle around to the side to target Azir himself while his soldiers are stopped. Prepare Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear when Azir dashes with E Shifting Sands, and avoid engaging in narrow passages where Azir R Emperor's Divide can knock you back.

Corki.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Corki deals mostly physical damage, and Vex has low armor, so build armor first. Corki P Hextech Munitions' true damage can't be blocked with armor, so it's also important to get out of range of Corki E Gatling Gun.
Corki.combo: Your basic trade is to slow with Vex E Looming Darkness, hit Vex Q Mistral Bolt, then consume any remaining Gloom mark with one auto attack. If Doom 'n Gloom is active, time your basic abilities carefully so you can respond to Corki W Valkyrie. Once Corki W Valkyrie has been used and you can secure a kill, hit with Vex R Shadow Surge, then recast it to go in.
Corki.escape: Don't force an engage while Corki W Valkyrie is available. The moment after Corki uses Corki W Valkyrie is your window while his escape is unavailable; if you can finish him, close the distance with Vex R Shadow Surge. Before going in with Vex R Shadow Surge, make sure Vex W Personal Space and Flash are available for after you land.
Corki.fight: When Corki steps forward to last-hit a minion, chip away at his health with Vex Q Mistral Bolt. If Corki comes in with Corki W Valkyrie, interrupt the dash and fear him with a basic ability empowered by Doom 'n Gloom; respond to the damage that follows with Vex W Personal Space. After Corki W Valkyrie has been used, slow him with Vex E Looming Darkness, and engage with Vex R Shadow Surge when you can finish him.
Corki.laning: Save Vex E Looming Darkness for fights, and don't spend Doom 'n Gloom while it's active on clearing minions. Corki gets stronger into the mid and late game the more freely he farms, so look for chances to pressure him during the first five levels.
Corki.phase: Corki gets stronger as he builds items, so don't let him fire missiles freely in the mid and late game. In the late game, Vex looks for chained engages through takedown resets on Vex R Shadow Surge.
Corki.teamfight: Instead of engaging first, interrupt Corki as he comes in with Corki W Valkyrie using a basic ability empowered by Doom 'n Gloom. Then catch the enemy backline with Vex E Looming Darkness. Go in with Vex R Shadow Surge and look for a reset once their formation is disrupted and a takedown is certain.
Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also damages targets near the first one hit, so don't hide behind minions; get out of range. Reposition to avoid being hit repeatedly, especially by the third missile. If Corki E Gatling Gun hits you, it reduces your armor and magic resistance, so move to the side instead of standing your ground in front of him. If Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb hits you and reveals your position, immediately create distance.

Diana.build: Diana deals mostly magic damage, and Vex has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If the enemy has several dive assassins, prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass ahead of damage items.
Diana.combo: Your basic trade is to slow with Vex E Looming Darkness, hit Vex Q Mistral Bolt, then weave in one auto attack if a mark remains. If Diana closes in with Diana E Lunar Rush, use Vex W Personal Space with Vex P Doom 'n Gloom active to apply fear and gain a shield at the same time. After engaging to finish with Vex R Shadow Surge, use Vex E Looming Darkness and Vex W Personal Space to survive.
Diana.escape: If Diana engages first with Diana E Lunar Rush without a Diana Q Crescent Strike mark on you, her mobility is unavailable for a window. Slow her with Vex E Looming Darkness to retaliate, and close the distance with Vex R Shadow Surge if you can finish her. If Diana Q Crescent Strike hits you, Diana E Lunar Rush may reset, so don't engage; create distance instead.
Diana.fight: After dodging Diana Q Crescent Strike, look for a chance to catch her with the slow from Vex E Looming Darkness once Diana E Lunar Rush is unavailable. Save Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear for Diana's engage, then apply it through a basic ability to interrupt her dash and retaliate. When engaging with Vex R Shadow Surge, choose a target you can finish and make sure Vex W Personal Space and Flash are available.
Diana.laning: Save Vex E Looming Darkness for fights, and retreat if you've spent Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear on the wave.
Diana.phase: In the late game, Vex R Shadow Surge becomes powerful for chained engages when it resets on a takedown, but it's hard to make an impact if the enemy team stays grouped and gives you no angle to engage.
Diana.teamfight: Use vision to block Diana's flank angles, and spread out so Diana R Moonfall doesn't pull several of you in together. As Diana E Lunar Rush comes out, empower a basic ability with Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear to interrupt her dash, then catch the backline with Vex E Looming Darkness. Use Vex R Shadow Surge on a target once the enemy formation is disrupted and a takedown is certain.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it flies, so sidestep instead of only retreating backward. If it hits and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush may reset, so immediately create distance. Don't fight up close just after Diana activates Diana W Pale Cascade, and keep your distance from allies so Diana R Moonfall doesn't pull several of you in together.

Ekko.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ekko deals mostly magic damage, and Vex has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy has several dive assassins, prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass so you can survive after engaging with Vex R Shadow Surge.
Ekko.combo: Your basic trade is to slow with Vex E Looming Darkness, hit Vex Q Mistral Bolt, then weave in one auto attack if a mark remains. If Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, use Vex W Personal Space with Vex P Doom 'n Gloom ready to apply fear and gain a shield at the same time. Once Ekko R Chronobreak has been used and you can secure a takedown, hit with the Vex R Shadow Surge mark, then dash in.
Ekko.escape: Avoid the area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence, and engage during the window when both Ekko E Phase Dive and Ekko R Chronobreak are unavailable. Ekko can escape with his remaining ability even after one movement ability is unavailable, so don't rush to recast Vex R Shadow Surge.
Ekko.fight: Save Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear until Ekko comes in with Ekko E Phase Dive. When Ekko gets close, use Vex W Personal Space to gain a shield, interrupt his engage with fear, and retaliate. Look to engage with Vex R Shadow Surge after Ekko R Chronobreak has been used and when you can finish him.
Ekko.laning: In the early game, farm with Vex Q Mistral Bolt and poke Ekko when he steps up to last-hit minions. Save Vex E Looming Darkness for trades, and don't spend Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear on the wave. While your fear is unavailable, watch for Ekko's engage and retreat behind your minions.
Ekko.phase: Vex R Shadow Surge's takedown reset is a strength in the late game, but don't recklessly chase Ekko while Ekko R Chronobreak is available.
Ekko.teamfight: Instead of engaging first, interrupt Ekko as he comes in with Ekko E Phase Dive using Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear. Then catch the enemy backline with Vex E Looming Darkness. Once Ekko R Chronobreak has been used and the enemy formation is disrupted, go in with Vex R Shadow Surge when a takedown is certain and look for a reset.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave its area to avoid the stun and shield. Also sidestep the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder. When you see the afterimage from Ekko R Chronobreak, don't recklessly chase him, even if health is low.

Fizz.build: Fizz deals mostly magic damage, and Vex has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If the enemy has several dive assassins, prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass ahead of damage items so you can survive after going in with Vex R Shadow Surge.
Fizz.combo: For a safe trade, slow with Vex E Looming Darkness, hit Vex Q Mistral Bolt, then weave in one auto attack if a Vex P Doom 'n Gloom mark remains. If fear is ready when Fizz gets close, interrupt his engage and gain a shield with Vex W Personal Space. If you successfully engage to finish with Vex R Shadow Surge, use Vex E Looming Darkness and Vex W Personal Space immediately after landing.
Fizz.escape: The window for Vex to go in is after Fizz E Playful / Trickster has been fully expended and before it becomes available again. If Fizz Q Urchin Strike is still available, he can use it to escape, so don't chase with Vex R Shadow Surge while only one of his movement abilities is unavailable. Close the distance with Vex R Shadow Surge once Fizz's movement abilities are unavailable and you can finish him.
Fizz.fight: Retaliate immediately after Fizz E Playful / Trickster has been fully expended, but don't chase recklessly if Fizz Q Urchin Strike is still available. When Fizz gets close first, interrupt his engage with Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear, and use Vex W Personal Space for a shield as his burst damage comes in. Use Vex R Shadow Surge when you can finish Fizz.
Fizz.laning: You have a trade window just after Fizz misses a last-hit with an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident auto attack or uses Fizz E Playful / Trickster.
Fizz.phase: In the late game, look for chained engages through takedown resets on Vex R Shadow Surge, but don't engage first if the enemy team stays grouped and gives you no angle.
Fizz.teamfight: Stand close to your allies and bait out Fizz E Playful / Trickster first. Interrupt Fizz as he comes in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike or Fizz E using Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear. If Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark detonates. Then catch the enemy backline with Vex E Looming Darkness, and use Vex R Shadow Surge when their formation is disrupted and a takedown is certain.
Fizz.watch: Fizz Q Urchin Strike and Fizz E Playful / Trickster are movement abilities that bring him onto Vex, so don't spend Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear early; interrupt him with a basic ability as he engages.

Galio.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Galio deals mostly magic damage, and Vex has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Galio.combo: Your basic trade is to slow with Vex E Looming Darkness, hit Vex Q Mistral Bolt, then consume a remaining Vex P Doom 'n Gloom mark with one auto attack. The moment Galio engages with Galio E Justice Punch, apply your saved fear through a basic ability to interrupt the dash, then use Vex W Personal Space for a shield as the damage comes in. Follow up with Vex R Shadow Surge when you can finish the target and survive after landing.
Galio.escape: In particular, look for a chance to close the distance with Vex R Shadow Surge before Galio R Hero's Entrance comes back up. If only Galio E Justice Punch has been used, check his remaining movement options.
Galio.fight: Save Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear for Galio E Justice Punch; when he engages, interrupt the dash with a basic ability and retaliate. While Galio charges Galio W Shield of Durand, stop trading and leave taunt range. Check Galio's remaining movement options, and use Vex R Shadow Surge on a target you can finish.
Galio.laning: When Galio steps forward for a melee attack, use Vex Q Mistral Bolt to farm and poke at the same time. Save Vex E Looming Darkness and Vex W Personal Space for a fight, and hold Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear for Galio's engage. If Galio spends mana using his abilities to clear the wave, push the lane to limit his room to roam.
Galio.phase: In the late game, Vex is strong when chaining engages through Vex R Shadow Surge resets, so don't engage first if the enemy team stays grouped and gives you no angle.
Galio.teamfight: Don't engage first. As Galio comes in with Galio E Justice Punch or Galio R Hero's Entrance, interrupt the dash with a basic ability empowered by Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear. When Galio R Hero's Entrance's landing area appears, move out of range, then catch the enemy backline with Vex E Looming Darkness. Go in with Vex R Shadow Surge and look for a reset once the enemy formation is disrupted and a takedown is certain.
Galio.watch: When Galio charges Galio W Shield of Durand, he takes reduced damage and the taunt lasts longer, so don't commit damage; walk out of range. Dodge Galio E Justice Punch when you see him pull back before charging forward, and avoid the point where both gusts from Galio Q Winds of War overlap. As soon as the landing area for Galio R Hero's Entrance appears, leave the area.

Hwei.build: Use a Null-Magic Mantle to hold on in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Hwei deals mostly magic damage, so Vex should build magic resistance first.
Hwei.combo: First slow with Vex E Looming Darkness, then hit Vex Q Mistral Bolt; weave in one auto attack if a Gloom mark remains.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility, so go in with Vex R Shadow Surge after Hwei E Subject: Torment is unavailable. If that ability is still available, it can knock you back or root you during your engage, so wait.
Hwei.fight: The moment after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or wave clear is your chance to close the distance with Vex R Shadow Surge. Before engaging, make sure you can finish the target; after landing, use Vex W Personal Space for a shield.
Hwei.laning: In the early game, farm and poke with Vex Q Mistral Bolt, hitting Hwei when he steps up to last-hit minions. Save Vex E Looming Darkness for trades, and immediately reposition if Hwei's first ability hits you.
Hwei.teamfight: Don't engage first; wait until Hwei E Subject: Torment is unavailable or the enemy formation is disrupted. Catch the backline with Vex E Looming Darkness, then hit a target you can finish with Vex R Shadow Surge and look for a reset.
Hwei.watch: If Hwei E Subject: Torment roots or forcibly moves you, you may also take follow-up damage, so avoid engaging while this ability is available. If Hwei's first ability hits you, immediately reposition to avoid his second ability and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.

Irelia.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Irelia deals mostly physical damage, and Vex has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Irelia.combo: For a trade, slow Irelia with Vex E Looming Darkness, hit her with Vex Q Mistral Bolt, and weave in one basic attack if the mark remains. If Irelia gets close, put Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear on Vex W Personal Space to interrupt her dash and gain a shield.
Irelia.escape: Immediately after you force Irelia to use Irelia Q Bladesurge is your window to engage with Vex R Shadow Surge. Check whether the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet is also unavailable, and make sure Vex W Personal Space and Flash are available before engaging with R.
Irelia.fight: Save Vex P Doom 'n Gloom until Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge to engage. Then interrupt the dash with a basic ability empowered by fear and counterattack. Look for a chance to close the gap with Vex R Shadow Surge right after Irelia uses Q.
Irelia.laning: Use Vex Q Mistral Bolt to farm and poke, and harass Irelia when she steps up to last-hit. Don't leave a half-health minion between you that Irelia can dash to, and save Vex E Looming Darkness for a fight. If you use Vex P Doom 'n Gloom to clear minions, back away.
Irelia.phase: In the late game, R resets let you chain engages, so look for a target you can finish off.
Irelia.teamfight: Don't engage first. When Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge, interrupt the dash with a basic ability empowered by Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear. Prioritize Irelia and use Vex E Looming Darkness to lock down the enemy backline. Use Vex R Shadow Surge after the enemy formation breaks apart and a kill is certain.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain through low-health minions to close the gap, so keep your distance when minions are about to die. Watch out for Irelia E Flawless Duet's stun. If you're trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Karma.build: In the early game, build Null-Magic Mantle first to hold on, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Karma's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Karma.combo: Your standard trade is to slow with Vex E Looming Darkness, hit with Vex Q Mistral Bolt, then use one basic attack if the Gloom mark remains. If Doom is active, apply Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear with the long-range Vex Q Mistral Bolt or the wide-area Vex E Looming Darkness. When you can finish a target, hit them with Vex R Shadow Surge, recast it to dash in, then use Vex E Looming Darkness and Vex W Personal Space after landing.
Karma.escape: The window to close the gap with Vex R Shadow Surge is after Karma W Focused Resolve is down and Karma E Inspire's shield and movement speed have ended. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects first, don't continue the engage; create distance before it roots you.
Karma.fight: Fight after Karma W Focused Resolve is down and Karma E Inspire's shield has ended. In a standard trade, slow her with Vex E Looming Darkness, hit her with Vex Q Mistral Bolt, then weave in one basic attack if the Gloom mark remains and back away. When engaging with Vex R Shadow Surge, choose a target you can finish and check that Vex W Personal Space and Flash are available.
Karma.laning: Save Vex E Looming Darkness for trades, and dodge Karma Q Inner Flame by repositioning behind minions or outside its range. If Karma W Focused Resolve catches you, time Vex W Personal Space's shield for when the damage comes in, then create distance before the root.
Karma.phase: In the late game, Vex R Shadow Surge's kill reset is a strength, but don't rush an engage if the enemy team is grouped and gives you no angle for R.
Karma.teamfight: Don't engage first; keep your distance until Karma W Focused Resolve is down. If Karma R Mantra empowers Karma E Inspire and shields nearby allies, attack after the shield ends. When the enemy formation breaks apart and a finish is certain, lock down the backline with Vex E Looming Darkness and look for a kill with Vex R Shadow Surge.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame applies an area slow, and when empowered by Karma R Mantra, its lingering zone explodes again, so walk out of the circle as soon as it hits you. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create distance to break the tether before it roots you. Don't force a chase while Karma E Inspire's shield and movement speed are active.

Kassadin.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Kassadin deals mostly magic damage, so Vex should build magic resistance first. If the enemy team has several diving assassins, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier than other damage items so you can survive after engaging with Vex R Shadow Surge.
Kassadin.combo: After Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield is down, slow him with Vex E Looming Darkness and fire Vex Q Mistral Bolt. If Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's mark remains, consume it with one basic attack and back away. If Kassadin gets close, put Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear on Vex W Personal Space to counterattack.
Kassadin.escape: If you can finish him off during that opening, close the gap with Vex R Shadow Surge. After dashing in with Vex R Shadow Surge, you have no mobility, so first make sure Vex W Personal Space and Flash are available.
Kassadin.fight: If Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield is down, slow him with Vex E Looming Darkness and hit him with Vex Q Mistral Bolt. When Kassadin can engage with Kassadin R Riftwalk, save Vex P Doom 'n Gloom and Vex W Personal Space.
Kassadin.laning: Use Vex Q Mistral Bolt to farm and poke, but save Vex E Looming Darkness when you expect a fight. When you use Vex P Doom 'n Gloom on the wave, Kassadin can close in, so back away behind your minions.
Kassadin.phase: In the late game, Kassadin can get into the backline and escape, so don't stand alone. Look for a chance to finish a target and reset Vex R Shadow Surge with a kill.
Kassadin.teamfight: Don't engage first. When Kassadin engages with Kassadin R Riftwalk, interrupt the dash with a basic ability empowered by Vex P Doom 'n Gloom. Then slow the enemy backline with Vex E Looming Darkness. When the enemy formation breaks apart and a finish is certain, engage with Vex R Shadow Surge and look for a kill to reset it.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere grants a shield that absorbs magic damage, so poke while that shield is down. Save Vex P Doom 'n Gloom for Kassadin's approach with Kassadin R Riftwalk, then interrupt his dash and fear him with a basic ability as he closes in. Avoid spamming abilities near Kassadin, since it reduces Kassadin E Force Pulse's cooldown; use only the abilities you need.

Leblanc.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. LeBlanc deals mostly magic damage, and Vex has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Leblanc.combo: From long range, slow LeBlanc with Vex E Looming Darkness and fire Vex Q Mistral Bolt. If Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's mark remains, consume it with one basic attack and back away. If LeBlanc closes in with LeBlanc W Distortion, put your saved fear on a basic ability to interrupt the dash, and use Vex W Personal Space for its shield when the burst damage comes in.
Leblanc.escape: The moment after you force LeBlanc to use LeBlanc W Distortion is a chance to close the gap, but it's more reliable to engage after the time for her to return to her original position has ended or she has already used the return. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, move out of chain range before the root takes hold; you can use Vex R Shadow Surge to get away.
Leblanc.fight: When LeBlanc engages with LeBlanc W Distortion, interrupt the dash and fear her with a basic ability using your saved Vex P Doom 'n Gloom, then counterattack. Before closing the gap yourself, check whether LeBlanc W Distortion's return window has ended or she has already used the return. Before engaging with Vex R Shadow Surge, check that you can finish the target and that Vex W Personal Space and Flash are available.
Leblanc.laning: Save Vex E Looming Darkness for trades, and back away if you use Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear to clear minions. Alert your team immediately if LeBlanc disappears from sight.
Leblanc.phase: In the late game, Vex R Shadow Surge's kill reset enables powerful chain engages, but it's hard to make an impact if the enemy team stays grouped and gives you no angle.
Leblanc.teamfight: Your first job is to interrupt LeBlanc's dash with a basic ability empowered by Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear as she engages with LeBlanc W Distortion. Then target the backline with Vex E Looming Darkness, and use Vex R Shadow Surge when the enemy formation is broken and a finish is certain. After dashing in, use Vex W Personal Space for its shield while looking for your next target.
Leblanc.watch: If LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice marks you, the next ability deals more damage, so don't step forward; back away until the mark disappears. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, get out of its range before the root takes hold. Be ready to fear her with Vex P Doom 'n Gloom when she engages with LeBlanc W Distortion.

Lissandra.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game. Lissandra deals mostly magic damage and Vex has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots.
Lissandra.combo: Your standard trade is to slow with Vex E Looming Darkness, hit with Vex Q Mistral Bolt, then use a basic attack if the mark remains. If Lissandra gets close, put your saved Vex P Doom 'n Gloom fear on a basic ability to interrupt her engage, and use Vex W Personal Space for its shield when the burst damage comes in. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is available, spread out your damage until her self-targeted stasis ends.
Lissandra.escape: Keep Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear ready to stop Lissandra from recasting Lissandra E Glacial Path to engage while it travels. The window for Vex to engage is after Lissandra E Glacial Path has been used or right after Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down. When engaging with Vex R Shadow Surge, choose a target you can finish and check that Vex W Personal Space and Flash are available.
Lissandra.fight: Trade right after Lissandra W Ring of Frost is used on the wave or misses. Slow her with Vex E Looming Darkness, hit her with Vex Q Mistral Bolt, and weave in one basic attack if the mark remains. Once Lissandra E Glacial Path is down, you can close the gap with Vex R Shadow Surge.
Lissandra.laning: Stand at an angle to your allied minions to avoid Lissandra Q Ice Shard's piercing path. Farm with Vex Q Mistral Bolt and poke Lissandra when she steps up to last-hit, saving Vex E Looming Darkness for a fight. While Lissandra can engage, don't use Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear on the wave.
Lissandra.phase: In the late game, Vex R Shadow Surge's kill reset is powerful, but your impact falls if the enemy team groups up and gives you no angle to engage.
Lissandra.teamfight: First, interrupt Lissandra as she engages with Lissandra E Glacial Path using a basic ability empowered by Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear. Then lock down the enemy backline with Vex E Looming Darkness, and use Vex R Shadow Surge after the formation breaks apart and a finish is certain. If Lissandra is the target of Vex R Shadow Surge, check whether Lissandra R Frozen Tomb's self-targeted stasis is still available.
Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces after hitting an allied minion, so don't stand in a line with your minions. When Lissandra E Glacial Path comes toward you, save Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear in case she recasts it to engage. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is available, its self-targeted stasis can cause your finishing damage to miss.

Lux.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Lux deals mostly magic damage, and Vex has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Lux.combo: Throw Vex E Looming Darkness from range to slow Lux, then fire Vex Q Mistral Bolt and weave in one basic attack if the mark remains. If Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear is ready, apply it with the long-range Q or the wide-area E. Use Vex R Shadow Surge to mark Lux when Lux Q Light Binding is down and you can finish her, then recast R to dash in.
Lux.escape: The moment after Lux Q Light Binding misses is your chance to engage with Vex R Shadow Surge. Lux has no mobility ability, so she has trouble escaping after you close the gap, but Vex also has no mobility after the R dash; check that Vex W Personal Space and Flash are available before engaging.
Lux.fight: Bait out and dodge Lux Q Light Binding, then slow her with Vex E Looming Darkness and hit her with Vex Q Mistral Bolt. If Lux Q is down and you have an angle to finish her, close the gap with Vex R Shadow Surge. Use Vex W Personal Space's shield when Lux's burst damage comes in.
Lux.laning: Use Vex Q Mistral Bolt to farm and poke, and harass Lux when she steps forward to last-hit. Save Vex E Looming Darkness for trades, and don't waste Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear on the wave. Lux Q Light Binding can hit allies in front of you, so don't stand in a line with them.
Lux.phase: In the late game, R resets let you chain engages, but it's hard to engage if the enemy team is grouped and gives you no angle for R.
Lux.teamfight: Spread out from your allies and approach from another direction so you aren't caught with them in Lux E Lucent Singularity. Vex should interrupt the enemy engage with Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear rather than engaging first, then target the backline with Vex E Looming Darkness. Engage with Vex R Shadow Surge when Lux Q Light Binding is down, the formation is broken, and a finish is certain.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, you're likely to be hit by follow-up abilities in quick succession, so don't stand in a line with your allies and bait out Q to dodge it. Leave the area covered by Lux E Lucent Singularity, and sidestep when you see the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark. If Lux's abilities hit you, create distance so Lux P Illumination's mark can't be triggered by a basic attack.

Malzahar.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Malzahar's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for your boots and prioritize magic resistance. Malzahar R Nether Grasp deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase your health.
Malzahar.combo: Break Malzahar P Void Shift first, then slow him with Vex E Looming Darkness and hit him with Vex Q Mistral Bolt. If Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's mark remains, consume it with one basic attack and back away. Hit with Vex R Shadow Surge when you can finish him, then use Vex W Personal Space for its shield after dashing in.
Malzahar.escape: Malzahar has no ability to create distance on his own, so break Malzahar P Void Shift, dodge Malzahar Q Call of the Void, then close the gap. If Malzahar can use Malzahar R Nether Grasp, don't engage alone with Vex R Shadow Surge. Engage with Vex R Shadow Surge during a window when you can avoid Malzahar's silence and suppression.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, break it first with Vex Q Mistral Bolt, then apply crowd control and damage. Your window to engage is after you dodge Malzahar Q Call of the Void and when Malzahar can't use Malzahar R Nether Grasp. If Malzahar W Void Swarm's summons are already out, clear them with Vex's area abilities before fighting.
Malzahar.laning: In the early game, use Vex Q Mistral Bolt to farm and poke when Malzahar steps up to hit minions, and save Vex E Looming Darkness for trades. Keep your distance from minions affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions and wait until the transfers have ended. If Malzahar pushes the lane, break Malzahar P Void Shift, then pressure him with your jungler to slow his growth.
Malzahar.phase: Malzahar gets stronger as the game goes on, so pressure him early. In the late game, look for a chance to finish a target and reset Vex R Shadow Surge with a kill.
Malzahar.teamfight: Position with your allies and watch out for Malzahar Q Call of the Void and Malzahar R Nether Grasp instead of engaging first. If Malzahar W Void Swarm's summons are out, clear them with Vex's area abilities, break Malzahar P Void Shift, then slow him with Vex E Looming Darkness. When the enemy formation breaks apart and a kill is certain, engage with Vex R Shadow Surge and look for a reset.
Malzahar.watch: If a minion affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect transfers to a nearby target, so don't wait for a last-hit beside that minion. When you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, move outside the rift, and don't engage before the silence ends. Malzahar R Nether Grasp's suppression can't be escaped with Vex W Personal Space's shield or Vex R Shadow Surge's movement.

Mel.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Mel's main damage is magic, and Vex has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Mel.combo: After Mel W Rebuttal is down, throw Vex E Looming Darkness from range to slow her, then hit the slowed Mel with Vex Q Mistral Bolt. If the Gloom mark remains, weave in one basic attack and back away. Only when a finish is certain, hit with Vex R Shadow Surge and recast it to engage; after landing, use Vex W Personal Space for its shield.
Mel.escape: Mel has no mobility ability, so the window to close the gap with Vex R Shadow Surge is after Mel W Rebuttal is down and you dodge Mel E Solar Snare. After engaging with R, you have no mobility, so check that Vex W Personal Space and Flash are available.
Mel.fight: Briefly poke Mel with Vex Q Mistral Bolt when she steps up to last-hit. If you have first baited out Mel W Rebuttal and sidestepped Mel E Solar Snare, slow her with Vex E Looming Darkness and fight. Use Vex R Shadow Surge only when you can finish her and have a way to survive after landing.
Mel.laning: Use Q to farm and poke, and save Vex E Looming Darkness for a fight. Mel gets stronger as the game goes on, so push the lane or pressure her early to limit her time to grow.
Mel.phase: Pressure the lane early to slow Mel's growth. Mel gets stronger as she stacks up, making her harder to deal with over time, so don't let fights drag on.
Mel.teamfight: Don't engage first. Sidestep Mel E Solar Snare, and use Vex W Personal Space's shield when Mel Q Radiant Volley comes in at the same time. After Mel W Rebuttal is down, target the backline with Vex E Looming Darkness. Use Vex R Shadow Surge when the enemy formation is broken and you can get a kill to reset it.
Mel.watch: Mel E Solar Snare roots you if you get hit in the center, making it easy to get hit by Mel Q Radiant Volley afterward, so sidestep it. Don't throw key projectiles like Vex Q Mistral Bolt or Vex R Shadow Surge while Mel W Rebuttal is active. If Mel P Searing Brilliance hits you several times, back away even if you still have health, and after a fight wait somewhere safe until the stacks disappear.

Naafiri.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Naafiri deals mostly physical damage, and Vex has low armor, so build armor first. If the enemy team has several engage assassins, build Zhonya's Hourglass before other damage items.
Naafiri.combo: For trades, slow with Vex E Looming Darkness, hit with Vex Q Mistral Bolt, then add one basic attack if the mark remains. If Naafiri is already on you, put Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear on Vex W Personal Space to interrupt her dash and absorb damage with the shield.
Naafiri.escape: Don’t use Vex R Shadow Surge to go in just because Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers or Naafiri E Eviscerate is down. Check her remaining mobility spells, and look especially for a target you can finish before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes back. Don’t rush your engage while Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit’s slow is still active.
Naafiri.fight: Briefly poke Naafiri when she steps up to last-hit minions, and save Vex P Doom 'n Gloom for when she tries to engage. Interrupt Naafiri E Eviscerate's dash with fear, then counterattack. Use Vex R Shadow Surge only on targets you can finish, and check that Vex W Personal Space and Flash are available before you dash in.
Naafiri.laning: Farm and poke with Vex Q Mistral Bolt from behind your minion wave, and save Vex E Looming Darkness for a fight. When Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is active, don’t spend it clearing minions; keep it ready for Naafiri’s engage. If you’ve used your fear, back away because Naafiri can engage freely.
Naafiri.phase: Once you have Vex E Looming Darkness, you can gain lane priority, but watch for Naafiri’s roams in the mid game and maintain wide vision.
Naafiri.teamfight: Don’t engage first. When Naafiri engages, interrupt her dash with a basic ability empowered by Vex P Doom 'n Gloom. Use Vex R Shadow Surge only after the enemy formation breaks and a finish is certain.
Naafiri.watch: If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits you once, create distance until the bleed ends to avoid the second hit. Save Vex P Doom 'n Gloom to fear and interrupt Naafiri E Eviscerate when she dashes in. If Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is still available, don't move around alone.

Neeko.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Neeko deals mostly magic damage, and Vex has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If being rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and then hit by Neeko R Pop Blossom would kill you, prioritize tenacity.
Neeko.combo: The basic trade is to slow with Vex E Looming Darkness, hit with Vex Q Mistral Bolt, then consume the Gloom mark with a basic attack if it remains. If Neeko is already on you, apply fear through Vex W Personal Space and absorb damage with the shield.
Neeko.escape: If Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, use that window to trade while you can avoid the root. When dashing with Vex R Shadow Surge, choose a target you can finish and check that Vex W Personal Space and Flash are available.
Neeko.fight: Damage Neeko with Vex Q Mistral Bolt when she steps up to last-hit minions. For a trade, slow with Vex E Looming Darkness, hit with Vex Q Mistral Bolt, then add one basic attack if the mark remains. When Neeko engages with Neeko R Pop Blossom, use a basic ability with your saved Doom 'n Gloom to interrupt her dash and apply fear. Once she’s on you, use the shield from Vex W Personal Space to absorb the incoming damage.
Neeko.laning: Save Vex E Looming Darkness for trades, and don’t spend Doom 'n Gloom on the wave. While Doom 'n Gloom is down, watch for Neeko’s engage and back away behind your minions.
Neeko.phase: In the late game, Vex is strong at chaining engages when kills reset Vex R Shadow Surge, but her impact drops if the enemy groups up and gives her no opening to engage.
Neeko.teamfight: Spread out from allies so Neeko E Tangle-Barbs can’t root several of you at once. When Neeko engages with Neeko R Pop Blossom, interrupt her dash with a basic ability empowered by Doom 'n Gloom. Once she’s on you and damage comes in, shield yourself with Vex W Personal Space. Then catch the backline with Vex E Looming Darkness, and engage with Vex R Shadow Surge once the formation breaks and a finish is certain.
Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up if it hits something first, so don’t stand grouped with allies. If Neeko approaches while disguised, you may not see Neeko R Pop Blossom’s windup, so spread out as soon as a suspicious-looking enemy gets close. Don’t chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter; watch for the real Neeko’s position.

Orianna.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Orianna’s magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for your boots, and build magic resistance first.
Orianna.combo: The basic sequence is to slow with Vex E Looming Darkness, hit with Vex Q Mistral Bolt, then add one basic attack if the mark remains. If Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear is ready, apply it with the long-range Vex Q Mistral Bolt or the wide-area Vex E Looming Darkness.
Orianna.escape: Orianna has no ability to create distance on her own, so look for an engage when her ball is away from her and you can avoid the danger zone of Orianna R Command: Shockwave. Before going in with Vex R Shadow Surge, check whether Orianna’s defensive tools have been used and whether Vex W Personal Space and Flash are available.
Orianna.fight: The moment after Orianna moves her ball away from herself with Orianna Q Command: Attack is a chance to trade. Slow with Vex E Looming Darkness, hit with Vex Q Mistral Bolt, then add one basic attack if the mark remains and back away. Before closing the distance with Vex R Shadow Surge, make sure you can finish the target.
Orianna.laning: Farm and poke with Vex Q Mistral Bolt when Orianna steps up to last-hit minions. Save Vex E Looming Darkness for trades.
Orianna.phase: In the late game, resets after kills on Vex R Shadow Surge are powerful, but engaging becomes difficult if the enemy groups up and gives you no opening for R.
Orianna.teamfight: Watch where Orianna’s ball is as you position so Orianna R Command: Shockwave doesn’t pull several allies in. Vex should avoid engaging first; catch the backline with Vex E Looming Darkness, then hit a target you are certain to finish with Vex R Shadow Surge. If a kill resets R, go for the next target.
Orianna.watch: After Orianna moves her ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack, avoid the spot where it lands. Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in around it, and you also need to watch for the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance.

Qiyana.build: Qiyana deals mostly physical damage, and Vex has relatively low armor, so start with Cloth Armor, build armor first, and choose Plated Steelcaps. If the enemy team has several engage assassins, build Zhonya's Hourglass before damage items so you can survive after going in with Vex R Shadow Surge.
Qiyana.combo: Keep your distance, slow with Vex E Looming Darkness, then hit with Vex Q Mistral Bolt and add one basic attack if the mark remains. If Qiyana is already on you, put Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear on Vex W Personal Space to interrupt her dash and absorb damage with the shield.
Qiyana.escape: Don’t rush in when only Qiyana W Terrashape is down; she can still escape with Qiyana E Audacity. After she’s used both mobility spells, especially before Qiyana E Audacity comes back, you have a chance to close the distance with Vex R Shadow Surge. Avoid terrain where Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent can hit you, and check that Vex W Personal Space is available.
Qiyana.fight: Save Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear for when Qiyana engages with Qiyana W Terrashape or Qiyana E Audacity. Interrupt her dash with a basic ability as she goes in, then counterattack. If Qiyana uses a mobility spell and stays in front of you, trade with her. Recast Vex R Shadow Surge to go in only on a target you can finish.
Qiyana.laning: Farm with Vex Q Mistral Bolt and poke Qiyana when she steps up to last-hit minions. Save Vex E Looming Darkness for a fight. If Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear is down, it’s difficult to stop Qiyana’s engage, so back away behind your minions.
Qiyana.phase: Qiyana is strongest in the mid game, so don’t give her an advantage; build armor and move with your allies. Qiyana is relatively weaker in the late game, and Vex can chain engages with takedown resets on Vex R Shadow Surge.
Qiyana.teamfight: Don’t engage first. Interrupt Qiyana’s engage with Qiyana W Terrashape or Qiyana E Audacity using the fear from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom. Then control the enemy back line with Vex E Looming Darkness, and use Vex R Shadow Surge when the formation breaks and a takedown is assured. Even when grouped with allies, stay away from terrain so Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent can’t hit you all together.
Qiyana.watch: Depending on the element, Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal can lead to a root or stealth. If she approaches holding river element, create distance first; if she disappears with brush element, move into your allies’ vision. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes and stuns when it hits terrain, so keep your back off walls and avoid meeting her by the river or in narrow passages.

Ryze.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Ryze’s magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for your boots and build magic resistance first.
Ryze.combo: First slow with Vex E Looming Darkness, then hit with Vex Q Mistral Bolt and consume the Vex P Doom 'n Gloom mark with a basic attack if it remains. If Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear is ready, apply it to Ryze with the long-range Q or wide-area E. Hit a target you can finish with Vex R Shadow Surge, and use the shield from Vex W Personal Space after dashing in.
Ryze.escape: If you dodge Ryze E Spell Flux, Ryze W Rune Prison only slows you instead of rooting you, so you can look for an opening to engage. Before going in with Vex R Shadow Surge, check that Vex W Personal Space is available.
Ryze.fight: Briefly poke Ryze with Vex Q Mistral Bolt when he steps up to last-hit minions. For a trade, slow with Vex E Looming Darkness, hit with Q, then add a basic attack if the mark remains. While Ryze R Realm Warp is down, you can close the distance with Vex R Shadow Surge, but go in only when you can finish the target and Vex W Personal Space is available.
Ryze.laning: Farm and poke with Q, and save Vex E Looming Darkness for a fight. Pressure Ryze before he scales, but if Ryze E Spell Flux hits you, keep your distance until the mark disappears.
Ryze.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so delay his scaling before he has his items. In the late game, takedown resets on Vex R Shadow Surge are powerful, but don’t rush an engage if the enemy groups up and gives you no opening.
Ryze.teamfight: Then slow the enemy back line with Vex E Looming Darkness. If you have a chance to finish Ryze, go in with Vex R Shadow Surge and look for a reset.
Ryze.watch: If Ryze E Spell Flux marks you, Ryze W Rune Prison becomes a root and Ryze Q Overload deals more damage, so prioritize dodging E. If you’re hit by the mark, separate from allies and keep your distance until it disappears. If you see Ryze R Realm Warp, look for a chance to interrupt Ryze with a basic ability empowered by Vex P Doom 'n Gloom before it activates.

Sylas.build: Sylas deals mostly magic damage, and Vex has relatively low magic resistance, so start by surviving with Null-Magic Mantle. Choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. If the enemy team has several engage assassins, build Zhonya's Hourglass before damage items to prepare for after you go in with Vex R Shadow Surge.
Sylas.combo: Keep your distance, slow with Vex E Looming Darkness, then fire Vex Q Mistral Bolt. If the Doom 'n Gloom mark remains, consume it with one basic attack. If Sylas is already on you, put Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear on Vex W Personal Space to interrupt his dash and shield yourself.
Sylas.escape: If only the first dash of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down, watch for the second chain. After dodging the chain and before Sylas E Abscond / Abduct comes back, you have a chance to close the distance with Vex R Shadow Surge. Sylas W Kingslayer is also a mobility spell, so account for the possibility of him escaping if it’s still available.
Sylas.fight: When Sylas tries to get close with Sylas W Kingslayer or Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, save Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear for a basic ability to interrupt his dash. Normally, slow with Vex E Looming Darkness, hit with Vex Q Mistral Bolt, then add one basic attack if the Doom 'n Gloom mark remains and back away. Use Vex R Shadow Surge only when you can finish the target and Vex W Personal Space is available for after you go in.
Sylas.laning: If you expect a trade, save Vex E Looming Darkness. If you’ve spent Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear on the minion wave, back away.
Sylas.phase: In the late game, you can chain engages with Vex R Shadow Surge resets, but wait to engage if the enemy groups up and gives you no opening.
Sylas.teamfight: Don’t engage first. When Sylas engages with Sylas W Kingslayer or Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, interrupt him with a basic ability empowered by Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear. Then control the back line with Vex E Looming Darkness, and keep your distance so Sylas can’t get in range to steal Vex R Shadow Surge. Use Vex R Shadow Surge once the formation breaks and a takedown is assured, then survive with the shield from Vex W Personal Space after landing.
Sylas.watch: With Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, the second chain is more dangerous than the first dash. If a chain hits you, it knocks you up and lets him follow up with more attacks, so use Flash to dodge the chain. Also move out of the intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash immediately. Sylas W Kingslayer heals more the lower his health is, so don’t delay finishing him.

Talon.build: In the early game, withstand Talon’s physical damage with Cloth Armor, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Build armor first, but also build health if Talon has built lethality. Talon has relatively high magic resistance, so include magic penetration when increasing Vex’s magic damage.
Talon.combo: For a safe trade, slow with Vex E Looming Darkness, hit with Vex Q Mistral Bolt, then add one basic attack if the Doom 'n Gloom mark remains. If Talon gets close, put Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear on a basic ability to interrupt his dash, then absorb damage with Vex W Personal Space.
Talon.escape: Once Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy and Talon E Assassin's Path are down, you have a chance to close the distance. Confirm that Talon has also used Talon R Shadow Assault, and if you can finish him, go in with Vex R Shadow Surge. Vex has no mobility spell to escape after using R to go in, so check that Vex W Personal Space and Flash are available first.
Talon.fight: Poke Talon a little at a time with Vex Q Mistral Bolt when he steps up to last-hit minions. If he dashes in, interrupt him with the saved fear from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom. When he gets close to deal burst damage, activate the shield from Vex W Personal Space. Use Vex R Shadow Surge when Talon’s mobility spells are down and you can finish him.
Talon.laning: Save Vex E Looming Darkness for a fight. If you’ve spent Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear on the wave, back away. If Talon roams, share his position with your team and place vision along the jungle path.
Talon.phase: Talon has less influence in the late game, so fight as a group. Vex should hit a target she can finish with R and look for a reset.
Talon.teamfight: If Talon goes for your back line, interrupt his dash from Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin's Path with a basic ability empowered by Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear. Then control the enemy back line with Vex E Looming Darkness, and group with your allies to layer crowd control on Talon. Use Vex R Shadow Surge after the enemy formation breaks and a takedown is assured, and look for a reset.
Talon.watch: If Talon W Rake hits you on the first pass, move out of its return path to prevent his passive stacks and bleed from triggering. When Talon approaches with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy and Talon E Assassin's Path, save Vex P Doom 'n Gloom, then interrupt his dash and apply fear with a basic ability. If Talon R Shadow Assault is still available, watch for his stealth and don’t overextend to chase him.

TwistedFate.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury’s Treads. Twisted Fate deals mostly magic damage, and Vex has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
TwistedFate.combo: When Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is down, slow him with Vex E Looming Darkness, then hit him with Vex Q Mistral Bolt; if the mark remains, weave in one basic attack. If Vex P Doom ’n Gloom’s fear is ready, apply it to the longer-range Vex Q Mistral Bolt or wider-area Vex E Looming Darkness. Hit a target with Vex R Shadow Surge when you can finish them, then use Vex W Personal Space’s shield after landing from the dash.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is used is your chance to engage.
TwistedFate.fight: Keep your distance when Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is ready, and fight right after he uses it. While Twisted Fate R Destiny is down, you can close the gap with Vex R Shadow Surge, but only engage if you can finish the target and Vex W Personal Space is available.
TwistedFate.laning: Early on, use Vex Q Mistral Bolt to farm and poke, hitting Twisted Fate when he steps up to last-hit minions. Save Vex E Looming Darkness for trades, and don’t spend Vex P Doom ’n Gloom’s fear on clearing minions when it’s active. If you see a roaming signal from Twisted Fate R Destiny, alert your allies immediately and have them retreat under their turrets on dangerous lanes.
